messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 20(7)

Article 20 Presumption of conformity of products within the scope of this Regulation. 7. Where a harmonised standard is adopted by a European standardisation organisation and proposed to the Commission for the purpose of publishing its reference in the Official Journal of the European Union , the Commission shall assess the harmonised standard in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012. When reference of a harmonised standard is published in the Official Journal of the European Union , the Commission shall repeal the implementing acts referred to in paragraph 3, or parts thereof which cover the same essential health and safety requirements as those covered by that harmonised standard.

response.text:
Commission | shallAssess | harmonised standard | standard adopted by a European standardisation organisation and proposed to the Commission for publishing its reference in the Official Journal | "the Commission shall assess the harmonised standard in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012"
Commission assessment | isConductedUnder | Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012 | harmonised standard proposed to the Commission for publication of its reference | "in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1025/2012"
Commission | shallRepeal | implementing acts referred to in paragraph 3 | reference of harmonised standard is published in the Official Journal | "the Commission shall repeal the implementing acts referred to in paragraph 3"
Commission | shallRepealParts | parts of implementing acts referred to in paragraph 3 covering the same essential health and safety requirements | reference of harmonised standard is published in the Official Journal and those parts cover the same requirements as the harmonised standard | "or parts thereof which cover the same essential health and safety requirements as those covered by that harmonised standard"
